title: 第23章 双杀第24章 心结
content_zh:
韩林没有习得身法，但好在如今已是练气二层，常年吸收灵气之下，身体也相当灵活，见金光袭来，只凭身体本能就将其躲避过去。
曾平见状，暗道失算，自知已经奈何不得韩林，于是连岳青山也不管，直接转身就跑。
韩林心中杀机已现，岂能放曾平离开，一个箭步朝曾平追去，同时手掌一翻，一团火球砸向曾平后背。
曾平心中大骇，却来不及躲避，只听到嘭的一声，被砸的重重扑倒在地上。
不等曾平起身，韩林抓起一块石头就冲了上来，一脚跪压曾平后背，一手按住曾平后颈。
另一手高举石块，在曾平惊恐的眼神下，狠狠向下一砸。
啪！
头骨碎裂的声音响起。
“啊——！”
曾平嘴里发出凄厉的惨叫。
韩林心头一慌，不管三七二十一，对着曾平脑袋就是一阵连续猛砸，也不知是鲜血还是骨渣，飞的到处都是。
直到耳边听不见曾平的动静了，他才终于停下，大口喘息。
再看曾平脑袋，已经被砸的稀烂，不由心脏狂跳，手脚都有些发软。
“杀人了，杀人了——！”另一边的岳青山见此一幕，吓得尿了裤子，连滚带爬地想要逃走。
韩林听到呼声，顿时回过神来，抓着石头朝岳青山追去。
“不，不要杀我，不要杀我……”
“韩哥，我错了，我错了，求求你，求求你啊……”
岳青山见韩林满身鲜血的跑来，直接失去了逃跑的勇气，一边哭，一边求饶。
韩林跟岳青山谈不上生死大仇，只是岳青山此人比较势利，经常嘴上嘲讽韩林而已。
韩林见此情形，也不禁心软了一下。但一想到，自己已经杀死曾平，万一岳青山将此事抖露出去，那自己可就危险了！于是把心一横，冲上去对着岳青山脑袋就是狠狠一击。

岳青山惨叫一声，脑门上破开一个大洞，鲜血横流。一只手死死抓着韩林衣袖，“韩，韩哥，不要杀我……”
“要怪，就怪你自己吧！”
“我一开始，也想把你当朋友的。”韩林高举着石块，嘭的一下，再次重击在岳青山脑门上。
岳青山嘴巴一张，两眼瞪圆，再也没了任何动静。
连杀两人，韩林心中的恐惧竟消退了不少，心也变得冷静了下来。
他将现场仔细处理了一遍，随后一边肩头扛一个，向着北边那片未曾开发的荒野走去。
足足过了半个时辰，韩林才再次从黑暗之中走回来，出现在微弱的月光石路灯之下。
但此时，路灯下却多了另一人。
那是一个头戴玉冠的少年，他望着从黑暗中走出来的韩林，沉声问：“韩林你去哪了！曾平和岳青山呢？”
他之所以现在才来，只是为了避嫌。
同时偷偷去韩林石屋里面翻找了一遍，想要找到韩林“私藏”的灵石，结果却是一无所获。
可当他来到这里，却发现不光韩林不知所踪，就连曾平和岳青山也不见了踪影。
韩林皱了皱眉头，神色平静道：“我不知道你在说什么。”
“是吗，那你刚才干什么去了？”赵锐凌眯着眼睛道。
“尿急，撒了个尿。”
韩林说着，走到板车旁边，拉起板车向前面走，表面一副冷淡的样子，实则暗暗警惕着赵锐凌。
这赵锐凌是老牌练气二层，马上就练气三层了。
content_en:
Han Lin has not learned the body technique, but fortunately he is now at the second level of Qi training. After absorbing spiritual energy for many years, his body is also quite flexible. When he sees the golden light coming, he can avoid it with just his body instinct.
Seeing this, Zeng Ping secretly miscalculated and knew that there was nothing he could do about Han Lin, so he turned around and ran away without even paying attention to Yue Qingshan.
Han Lin had a murderous intention in his heart. How could he let Zeng Ping leave? He chased Zeng Ping with a single stride. At the same time, he flipped his palm and a ball of fire hit Zeng Ping's back.
Zeng Ping was horrified, but he had no time to escape. He only heard a bang and was hit hard and fell to the ground.
Before Zeng Ping could get up, Han Lin grabbed a stone and rushed forward. He knelt on Zeng Ping's back with one foot and pressed the back of Zeng Ping's neck with one hand.
The other hand raised the stone high, and under Zeng Ping's horrified eyes, he smashed it down hard.
Snap!
The sound of skull cracking sounded.
"Ah——!"
Zeng Ping let out a shrill scream.
Han Lin panicked. No matter what, he hit Zeng Ping's head continuously. He didn't know whether it was blood or bone residue, but it flew everywhere.
It wasn't until Zeng Ping's movement could no longer be heard in his ears that he finally stopped and took a big breath.
Looking at Zeng Ping's head again, it had been smashed to pieces. His heart was beating wildly and his hands and feet were a little weak.
"Killing, killing——!" Seeing this scene, Yue Qingshan on the other side was so frightened that he peed his pants and rolled around trying to escape.
When Han Lin heard the cry, he immediately came to his senses, grabbed the stone and chased Yue Qingshan.
"No, don't kill me, don't kill me..."
"Brother Han, I was wrong, I was wrong, please, please..."
When Yue Qingshan saw Han Lin running towards him covered in blood, he immediately lost the courage to escape, crying and begging for mercy.
There is no life-and-death feud between Han Lin and Yue Qingshan. It's just that Yue Qingshan is a snobbish person and often mocks Han Lin.
Seeing this situation, Han Lin couldn't help but feel soft. But when he thought that he had killed Zeng Ping, if Yue Qingshan exposed this matter, he would be in danger! So he suddenly rushed forward and gave Yue Qingshan a hard blow on the head.
Yue Qingshan screamed, a big hole opened in his forehead, and blood flowed horizontally. One hand firmly grasped Han Lin's sleeve, "Han, Brother Han, don't kill me..."
"If you want to blame it, blame yourself!"
"I also wanted to treat you as a friend from the beginning." Han Lin raised the stone high and hit Yue Qingshan on the forehead with a bang.
Yue Qingshan's mouth opened, his eyes widened, and there was no movement.
After killing two people in a row, the fear in Han Lin's heart actually subsided a lot, and he became calmer.
He carefully processed the scene, then carried one on his shoulders and walked towards the undeveloped wilderness to the north.
After half an hour, Han Lin came back from the darkness again and appeared under the weak moonstone street lamp.
But at this time, there was another person under the street light.
It was a young man wearing a jade crown. He looked at Han Lin walking out of the darkness and asked in a deep voice: "Han Lin, where have you been? Where are Zeng Ping and Yue Qingshan?"
The reason why he came now was just to avoid suspicion.
At the same time, he secretly rummaged through Han Lin's stone house, hoping to find Han Lin's "privately hidden" spirit stone, but found nothing.
But when he came here, he found that not only Han Lin was missing, but Zeng Ping and Yue Qingshan were also missing.
Han Lin frowned and said calmly, "I don't know what you are talking about."
"Really? Then what did you do just now?" Zhao Ruiling said with squinted eyes.
"I had an urgent need to pee."
Han Lin said, walked to the cart, pulled up the cart and walked forward, looking indifferent on the surface, but secretly wary of Zhao Ruiling.
This Zhao Ruiling is a veteran at the second level of Qi training, and will soon reach the third level of Qi training.
